# Automaticky generovane: debug skloňovania strán (cz_party_debug)

CZDBG_TYPE = {
  type = party
  log_loc_errors = yes
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = agrarian_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_agrarian_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = anarchist_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_anarchist_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = communist_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_communist_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = conservative_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_conservative_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = fascist_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_fascist_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = free_trade_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_free_trade_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = liberal_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_liberal_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = military_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_military_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = radical_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_radical_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = religious_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_religious_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = revolutionary_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_revolutionary_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { is_party_type = social_democrat_party }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_type_social_democrat_party
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { always = yes }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_no
  }
}

CZDBG_MEMBER_OWNER = {
  type = party
  log_loc_errors = yes
  text = {
    trigger = { any_member = { owner = { exists = this } } }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_yes
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { always = yes }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_no
  }
}

CZDBG_OWNER = {
  type = party
  log_loc_errors = yes
  text = {
    trigger = { owner = { exists = this } }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_yes
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { always = yes }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_no
  }
}

CZDBG_SCOPE_SEEN = {
  type = country
  log_loc_errors = yes
  text = {
    trigger = { exists = scope:cz_dbg_party_test }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_yes
  }
  text = {
    trigger = { always = yes }
    localization_key = cz_dbg_no
  }
}

  text = {

      					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
      					ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
      						party ?= {
      							is_party_type = agrarian_party
      						}
      						leader ?= {

  text = {

      						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
      					}
      					ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
      						party ?= {
      							is_party_type = agrarian_party
      						}

      								has_socialist_ideology = yes
